intent: Greedily improve the internet slice AMBR from 20 toward 60 Mbps. At each step: apply an increase via policy_manager, then check ambr_dl_mean with kpi_analyzer. If the KPI confirms improvement, immediately apply another increase — don't stop. After each KPI confirmation, always try one more increase. Use feasibility_checker. AMBR in bps. The target_slice parameter is 'internet'.
